The upstream README credits Material Icon Theme and its original authors:
https://github.com/material-extensions/vscode-material-icon-theme
Gruvbox Material Icons adapts that collection to the Gruvbox palette.

User-supplied provider marks (Huan, 2026-11-06)
brands/antigravity.svg: copied unchanged from the supplied file
Google-Antigravity-Icon-Full-Color.svg. The mark belongs to Google.
brands/synthetic-sciences.svg: Synthetic Sciences' mark, supplied by Huan
from https://syntheticsciences.ai/img/logo.svg. The mark belongs to
Synthetic Sciences.

Official provider mark without a redistribution license (2026-11-12)
brands/posit.svg: Posit's logo, copied unchanged from the header of
https://posit.co/ (the mark Posit Assistant's site shows); only its blue
and orange mark is used, without the wordmark or white background. The
mark belongs to Posit.
No redistribution license was supplied or found for this mark or the two
above. The MIT/ISC terms above do not cover them. Record permission or applicable
brand-use terms before a public release; attribution does not itself grant
permission.

Official agent marks (MIT, vendored 2026-11-12)
brands/oh-my-pi.svg: Oh My Pi's mark, copied unchanged from
https://omp.sh/favicon.svg, the same file as
https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/blob/b16bfbe0f9cf953d9a37fc17284967ed18fae015/packages/collab-web/public/favicon.svg
MIT License, Copyright (c) 2025 Mario Zechner, (c) 2025-2026 Can Bölük,
(c) 2026 Stencil Labs, Inc. See brands/oh-my-pi.LICENSE.
brands/pi.svg: pi's mark, copied unchanged from https://pi.dev/logo.svg;
the same mark is in https://github.com/earendil-works/pi (revision
3c9a86bb08398a425f95a81ba4339aa76151f5a1, apps/p2/public/icons/favicon.svg).
MIT License, Copyright (c) 2025 Mario Zechner. See brands/pi.LICENSE.

Adaptations by Sandhill: proportionally fit original SVG geometry into a
16px viewBox, namespace SVG definition IDs, let interface icons follow the
surrounding text color, fill the selected favourite star using the same
Lucide geometry, and place Developer Icons logos on a light rounded
backplate for contrast. Agent marks have no background (Huan): Oh My Pi's
dark tile and the white behind Posit's logo are not drawn, and Oh My Pi,
Posit and pi are cropped to the mark. The app draws the one-colour OpenAI
(Codex) and Synthetic Sciences marks in the surrounding text colour, so
they read on light and dark. Gruvbox colors are not recolored or
luminance-tuned. Original SVGs are retained without modification.

Third-party artwork retains its upstream license. Sandhill's GPL license
does not claim ownership of vendor trademarks or imply endorsement.
Icon source mappings and generic substitutions are listed in MAPPING.md.
Sandhill's crane and application icon are not part of these collections.
